ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

17. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)

22. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers
